problem_statement: website-templates/simple-product ("Prechu") is a static wireless-charging accessories store. It now has three real pages that share a header/nav and footer: a home page (promo slider, services band), a Shop page (a product catalogue grid) and a Product detail page. Two commerce features run across those pages. First, a shared "The Prechu promise" fulfilment rail (four tiles: Free UK delivery, Two-year warranty, 30-day returns, Secure checkout) appears on the home, shop and product pages so a shopper sees the same reassurance wherever they are. Second, the Shop page has a category filter (All / Chargers / Cables / Stands): clicking a tab re-renders the six-product grid and updates a live readout that reads "Showing N of 6 · <Category>"; a bag badge in the header counts items added to the bag. Complete and keep this cross-page commerce experience consistent: (1) the Prechu promise rail must appear on all three pages, unchanged in wording and order; (2) the promise rail must reflow within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow while keeping its clean, readable grey-green tile styling on every width; (3) the Shop category filter must genuinely re-filter the grid AND update the readout count/label to match the shown products (e.g. "Showing 2 of 6 · Chargers"); (4) the header/nav, footer, promo slider and services band must remain intact. The work spans the shared page markup, the store stylesheet (static/css/prechu-store.css) and the store script (static/js/prechu-shop.js).
required_content: The "The Prechu promise" fulfilment rail renders its four tiles (Free UK delivery, Two-year warranty, 30-day returns, Secure checkout) on the home, shop and product pages, unchanged in wording and order.
On a 390px mobile viewport the promise rail reflows within the viewport: the home and shop pages no longer scroll horizontally (document width equals viewport width beyond a small tolerance).
The promise tiles remain legible and cleanly laid out at every viewport (dark-green value text on a light card, thin border, rounded corners, no overlap or clipping).
The Shop category filter (All / Chargers / Cables / Stands) re-renders the product grid on click AND updates the readout to the matching count and label, e.g. "Showing 2 of 6 · Chargers".
The shared header/nav (with the bag badge), the footer, the promo slider and the services band remain intact and reachable across all pages.
design_constraints: Preserve the Prechu visual language: the muted grey-green palette, light tile cards with a thin border and rounded corners, dark-green value text, and generous section spacing.
Keep the promise rail a single labelled 'The Prechu promise' component and place it on the home, shop and product pages; do not reword, reorder or drop any of the four tiles on any page.
The promise rail must remain a horizontal row on desktop/tablet where space allows but must reflow (wrap) within the viewport on narrow (mobile) widths rather than forcing sideways scrolling.
Do not mask the mobile overflow by clipping the document or an inner tile with overflow-x:hidden; the tiles must genuinely fit the available width on mobile.

The Shop filter must update BOTH the visible grid AND the readout string on every tab click so the count and label always describe the products actually shown; a filter that changes the grid but leaves a stale readout is incorrect.

mobile_rail_home captures the same rail at 390px, where a broken fixed-width no-wrap layout forces horizontal document overflow; the reference wraps the tiles so the document fits the viewport.
tablet_rail_home captures the promise rail at 834px, where it already fits; the layout must not regress.
desktop_rail_shop scrolls the 1440px Shop page to 'The Prechu promise' rail, confirming the rail is present on the shop page (cross-page consistency).
mobile_rail_shop captures the Shop-page promise rail at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_shop_filter captures the 1440px Shop page catalogue with the filter tabs and the readout showing 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' before any tab is clicked.
desktop_shop_chargers clicks the 'Chargers' tab: the grid re-renders to the two charger products and the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Chargers'.
mobile_shop captures the Shop catalogue at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_rail_product scrolls the 1440px Product page to 'The Prechu promise' rail, confirming the rail is present on the product page (cross-page consistency).

change_completion: The Shop category filter re-renders the grid and updates the readout to the matching count and label (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Chargers') on tab click.
The promise rail renders its four tiles unchanged in wording and order, and the header/nav, footer, slider and services band remain intact and reachable.
design_consistency: The 'The Prechu promise' rail appears on the home, shop and product pages with the same tiles and styling (cross-page consistency).
The promise tiles keep the Prechu grey-green palette, light card fill, thin border, rounded corners and legible dark-green value text at every viewport.
responsive: The 390px home and shop pages have no horizontal overflow at the promise rail or elsewhere.
The 834px tablet and 1440px desktop promise-rail and shop layouts are preserved and continue to fit.
regression: The static site serves across home/shop/product with zero remote requests and zero console errors.
All non-graded sections (header/nav, footer, promo slider, services band, product copy) are unchanged.

author_notes: L4 commerce experience-continuity task on the Prechu store template. Native commerce levers: (D2) a shared 'The Prechu promise' fulfilment rail present on the home, shop and product pages; (D3) that rail's visual integrity on the home page (a broken build shingles the tiles with negative margins so they overlap and clips the value text to a near-white illegible fill); (D6) the rail's tile row must reflow within a 390px phone rather than a fixed no-wrap row that overflows the document; (D4) the Shop category filter must update both the product grid and the readout count/label on click (a stale-readout build re-filters the grid but freezes the readout at 'Showing 6 of 6 · All'). Leg-varying files: the three page HTML files (promise-rail presence per page), static/css/prechu-store.css (rail reflow + tile styling) and static/js/prechu-shop.js (filter readout wiring). Remote Google Fonts + FontAwesome are vendored to a local vendor.css declared INFRA (byte-identical across the three legs) so the store makes zero remote requests. Product imagery (iphone.png charger, card.jpg cable) and the basket asset are local. Screenshots reviewed: reference rail reads cleanly; the broken build's rail is visibly overlapped and illegible.
